:- prefix(ex, 'https://example.org/1428/').
ex:ans(X, D) :- X is 0, A is 3/4, B is 1/6, D is A - B.
?- ex:ans(X, D).

provenance.derivation: 3/4 - 1/6: common denominator 12 -> 9/12 - 2/12 = 7/12 (gcd(7,12)=1, already lowest terms). `X` is an unused dummy arg (`X is 0`) so the goal atom is arity >= 2, keeping the query on the binary backward path -- see the corpus README's arity note.
provenance.note: independently derived; never hand-edited to match the native engine
